Synchronous request interceptors are processed in a loop before asynchronous ones [1].

If any interceptor is not synchronous, the entire chain is handled asynchronously using Promises [1].

Response interceptors are always processed asynchronously, regardless of whether the request interceptors were synchronous or asynchronous [1].
